title: Studio Flow Actions configuration
description: Describes which Twilio Studio Flows to manage and how to resolve the account-specific values inside them.

$schema.description: Location of this schema, for editor completion and validation.

flows.description: The Studio Flows this configuration manages.

name.description: Friendly name of the flow. Used to locate it on the account unless 'sid' is given.

path.description: Location of the flow definition JSON, relative to the repository root.

sid.description: Targets one specific flow by SID, for when a friendly name is ambiguous.

subflow.description: Marks this flow as a subflow. Subflows are deployed before the flows that call them.

allowCreate.description: Permits the flow to be created when it is not already on the account, instead of failing.

replaceWidgetTypes.description: Widget types to rewrite at deploy time. A type left out of this list is published exactly as written.

functionServices.description: Twilio Functions services whose URLs may appear in run-function widgets. Every referenced service must be declared here.

name.description: Unique name of the service, or a regular expression when 'pattern' is enabled.

environmentSuffix.description: Domain suffix of the environment to read. Use null for an environment with no suffix, or 0 to take whichever environment comes first.

pattern.description: Treats 'name' as a regular expression. Use for services with generated names, such as Flex plugin library installs.

workflowMap.description: Pins a workflow name to a specific SID, taking precedence over the account lookup.

subflowMap.description: Pins a subflow name to a specific SID, taking precedence over the account lookup.

variableReplacements.description: Values written into matching set-variables widget keys. Keys a widget does not declare are ignored.

customPropertyReplacements.description: Direct property overrides, applied after all widget rewriting. Reaches any widget by name, including unmanaged types.

flowName.description: Name of the flow, matching a 'flows' entry.

widgetName.description: Name of the widget within that flow.

propertyKey.description: Property to set on the widget.

enableShellVariables.description: Expands $VAR references in this file from the environment before it is parsed. An unset variable expands to an empty string.
